verdict.rationale: Stripe Radar has a documented API reference covering endpoints such as POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve, early fraud warnings and value lists, plus sandbox test card numbers that produce specific risk levels. That makes it possible to exercise the API against a test environment. However, nothing in the evidence shows the reference itself is interactive or embeds runnable examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or try-it code examples in the reference, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and independent hands-on corroboration.
